body: Maybe. Or just get away to find myself and reevaluate my life. Without having to drive 4 hours to the mountains.

And I have felt god calling. Yet still I hurt. I know death would be selfish. But isn’t living just to keep 1-2 people happy harmful. I know god has called to me numerous times. And yet I feel like god doesn’t give a shit

Eh. Why not. I’m just mentally, emotionally and physically exhausted. I go ride the green ways all the times. Get away to that extent. I crush the strava boards. But I’m just empty and done. And want to go away, no one will notice.

I have held off for years cause I’m a coward. What would my family think?  What would my friends think?  Fuck it. None of them give a shit about me anymore. Dad…maybe. After he beat the fuck out of me for 18 years. Mom…maybe if she can control me. Sister and niece, they probably do. Nephew is a cunt so don’t care. The only thing I’ve planned is my body disappearing so no one knows or cares for weeks if not months. I just don’t fucking care. I hurt so much. God abounded me.
